name: Unicorn trend
summary: The unicorn trend was a 2016—2019 fad where individuals designed, produced, and use consumer goods which were adorned with unicorns and vibrantly colored designs; typically composed of rainbow, pastel, or highly saturated colors.
description: The unicorn trend was a 2016—2019 fad where individuals designed, produced, and use consumer goods which were adorned with unicorns and vibrantly colored designs; typically composed of rainbow, pastel, or highly saturated colors. This tendency has gained in popularity since 2016, especially among millennials, who typically associated it with childhood and as a form of escapism. Its popularity was augmented by influencer and celebrity culture on social media. Some examples of consumer products that are commonly decorated in this style are phone cases, clothing, water bottles, tote bags, makeup, and food.
